name: sdm_led
description: sdm_led, unmodified: a sigma-delta channel on GPIO0 at a 1 MHz sample rate (APB_CLK / 80), its density stepped by 2 every 10 ms between -110 and 90 and back, a triangle of 2 s. A density d makes (d + 128) / 256 of the bits high, so over any whole period the pin is high ((-10) + 128) / 256 = 46.1 % of the time; at its extremes 7 % and 85 %. The bits are 1 us long, so no stretch of the output is shorter.
